title: Quantum Optimized
description: For now, it's just an optimization pack with Quality of Life mods, but someday it will grow into something greater!
body:
**This modpack will boost your FPS!**

At its core, it’s powered by optimization mods, but it also includes essential QoL improvements.
I have big plans for this pack’s future, but your ideas are welcome too!

**Want to suggest something?** Reach me on Discord: kyurixd
